head:
Below are three short texts that a small language model wrote, each starting from the same prompt. Most of the time such texts are ordinary: each one is about its own topic.

Classify the three texts:
A = ORDINARY. Readable texts, each on its own topic. Nothing odd keeps coming back.
B = ONE THING. One specific thing keeps coming back in at least two of the texts: the same unusual word, name, topic, language, script or symbol. The texts may be broken or repetitive, but what they repeat is that one thing.
C = MIXED. The texts are odd or broken, but in different, unrelated ways: no single thing is shared.
